name: lyricsflip
description: LyricsFlip - A real-time multiplayer music game

scripts.//: npm workspaces: run a single `npm install` at the repo root. Do not run installs inside frontend/ or backend/; the root package-lock.json is the only lockfile.
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.check:contracts: cd onchain && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run test -- --passWithNoTests
scripts.check:backend: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix backend run test
scripts.check:all: npm run check:contracts && npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend
